issue.title: test_run_supervisor_chatty_command_does_not_hit_idle_timeout returns 1 in the full lane and passes serially
issue.description: Investigate the supervisor chatty-child completion failure without weakening the expected successful-completion contract. The fixture emits four flushed ticks 50 ms apart with a 200 ms idle limit. Scheduling pressure is a hypothesis; the exact cause is not established. Existing sase-nd covers a different no-hang bound, and sase-lk covers different EOF/teardown nodes.

task_type_fields.evidence: On 2026-10-24, ToolRun 9d45b02b05704de87208231c5e45c311 exited 1: this node returned 1 instead of 0 under 14 workers, with 57337 passed and 17 skipped. On the unchanged staged tree atop 7b1b437558, ToolRun 2ed316493c37896ce6bd24259b34a349 reran exactly this node with SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS=1 and exited 0. Observed rate on this tree: 1/1 failing broad runs, 0/1 failing serial reruns; insufficient evidence for a stable rate. The mandatory check remains a failed check, not a pass.

issue.creation_reason: A required conflict-repair check failed this node while 57,337 tests passed; the unchanged-tree serial rerun passed, so the intermittent failure needs durable investigation.
